info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Education Enrollments Materials-v1-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Materials Retrieval API provides access to a catalog of educational materials associated with various enrollment programs. This API allows users to easily retrieve information on available materials for specific courses or programs, supporting educators, administrators, and students alike. Typical consumers of this API include educational institutions planning their course content and students seeking additional learning resources. By offering a streamlined way to access these materials, the API enhances the educational experience and promotes resource availability.

get.description: This endpoint allows the user to fetch a list of materials associated with enrollment processes. It's essential for managing educational resources effectively.
